quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What should you do when driving near a large commercial vehicle?

options.text: Follow it closely to reduce wind drag on your car.
Do not drive beside it for long periods of time.
Drive on its right side when going around curves and hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive beside it for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Large commercial vehicles have large blind spots on both sides. Do not drive beside them for long periods of time.

questions.question: What will help someone overcome the effects of alcohol?

options.text: Tomato juice and lime
Hot coffee
Fresh air
Only time

questions.correctAnswerText: Only time
questions.explanation: Only time allows the body to overcome the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the exact speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: Which statement is true about railroad crossings?

options.text: You should use cruise control near a railroad crossing to stay at a constant speed.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
You have the right-of-way at a railroad crossing and do not need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing if a flagger, stop sign, or warning signal tells you to. Always be careful when driving near railroad tracks.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to the lane you came from.
The lane marked with an arrow.
The middle lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the lane you came from.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane closest to the lane you came from. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: When must you show proof of insurance to a police officer?

options.text: Only if you are in a collision.
If you are in a collision or stopped for a ticket.
Only if you are stopped and get a ticket.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are in a collision or stopped for a ticket.
questions.explanation: You must carry proof of insurance whenever you drive. You must show proof of insurance and your license to an officer after a traffic stop or collision.

questions.question: What is a major cause of rear-end collisions in work zones?

options.text: One driver driving faster or slower than surrounding traffic.
The lack of barricades warning drivers about road work.
Construction equipment blocking drivers' views.

questions.correctAnswerText: One driver driving faster or slower than surrounding traffic.
questions.explanation: Driving at a different speed than other cars is a major cause of rear-end collisions in work zones. Pay attention to traffic around you and follow posted speed limits in work areas.

questions.question: What should you do when driving near a blind pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.
Take the right-of-way.
Drive normally.
Drive away quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When you see a blind pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog, slow down, let them cross, and move forward carefully. Be ready to stop to protect the pedestrian.

questions.question: How should you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, let other traffic go first, and drive at the same speed as the traffic.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must let you in.
Drive slowly so you can check the traffic.
Always stop completely first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let other traffic go first, and drive at the same speed as the traffic.
questions.explanation: Signal and merge at the same speed as traffic. Always let other traffic go first when entering a road.

questions.question: You are parking uphill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the edge of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the edge of the road
questions.explanation: When parking uphill or downhill on a road with no curb, turn your wheels so the car will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail.

questions.question: You are driving on the interstate and see vehicles entering from a ramp on your right. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to get ahead of the vehicles on the entrance ramp.
Stay in your lane.
Move left to give them space to enter safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move left to give them space to enter safely.
questions.explanation: When you see vehicles entering the interstate from a ramp on your right, signal and move left to help them enter safely. If you cannot move left safely, slow down to help them merge.

questions.question: Which statement about drowsy drivers is true?

options.text: They should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
They can drive so poorly that they look drunk.
They can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.
They are usually only older drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can drive so poorly that they look drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so badly that they appear to be drunk. Opening a window, turning up the radio, or drinking coffee does not keep a drowsy driver alert to road hazards.

questions.question: In Nebraska, what is the blood alcohol concentration (BAC) limit for drivers under 21?

options.text: 0.02 percent
0.08 percent
0.1 percent

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.02 percent
questions.explanation: In Nebraska, drivers under 21 cannot drive with a BAC of 0.02 percent or higher.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Only use the rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
Only use the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes. You may need to look several times. Watch traffic in front of you and in the lane next to you.

questions.question: You have a green light, but traffic is blocking the intersection ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Wait until traffic clears before entering the intersection.
Follow other vehicles into the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until traffic clears before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if traffic is blocking your way, even if the light is green. If you enter and the light turns red, you will block cross traffic and may get a ticket.

questions.question: When do roads become most slippery?

options.text: After it has rained for an hour or more.
The day after it rains.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
Right after the rain stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. Heat makes this worse by bringing more oil to the road.

questions.question: You stop at a railroad crossing with multiple tracks. What should you do?

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go when the train passes.
Go when one track is free.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving.
questions.explanation: At a crossing with multiple tracks, do not move until you can see clearly down all tracks. Even with one track, wait after a train passes and check again for another train.

questions.question: What do rumble strips do?

options.text: Alert drivers to tire problems.
Test a vehicle's shock absorbers.
Use vibration and sound to alert inattentive drivers that they are leaving the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use vibration and sound to alert inattentive drivers that they are leaving the road.
questions.explanation: Rumble strips make noise and vibration to warn drowsy or inattentive drivers that they are leaving the road or approaching a stop sign or signal.

questions.question: What should you NOT do when changing lanes?

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Use your turn signal.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.
Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal. Check for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane.

questions.question: What does excessive speed do?

options.text: Does not increase the chance of a crash.
Improves your ability to react to hazards.
Often leads to risky decisions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often leads to risky decisions.
questions.explanation: Excessive speed is a leading cause of crashes. It does not save time and often leads to risky decisions.

questions.question: What can you do when you see a flashing yellow arrow at a traffic light?

options.text: Go in the direction of the arrow after stopping completely.
Go in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.
Go in the direction of the arrow without slowing down because you have the right-of-way.
Stop and stay stopped until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing yellow arrow, you can go in that direction. First, you must let any oncoming traffic and pedestrians go. Then you can proceed.

questions.question: When there is a green arrow at a red light, when can you go?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
After you wait for the light to change.
When you are in the correct lane and the road ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are in the correct lane and the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction when the road is clear. This is true whether the arrow appears alone or with other signal lights.

questions.question: Traffic is merging into your freeway lane. What should you do?

options.text: Make space for the merging traffic if you can.
Speed up to keep your position and hold your right-of-way.
Stay in your lane and do not move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make space for the merging traffic if you can.
questions.explanation: When it is safe, you should make room for other vehicles to merge into your lane.

questions.question: How much are speeding fines in work zones?

options.text: Reduced
Doubled
Tripled

questions.correctAnswerText: Doubled
questions.explanation: Speeding fines are doubled in work zones where workers are present and in school zones during certain hours. Always drive safely near workers, children, and other people.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop.
No U-turn.
Yield.
Do not enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.
